description: This file is a C source file implementing test functions for an RBUS element tree, including creating, inserting, removing, and MD5 checksum verification of elements in the tree.

methods.name: int md5sum(const char * file,char * md5)
methods.description: Computes the MD5 hash of a given file by executing the 'md5sum' command and parsing its output.

methods.name: void checkmd5(const char * name,elementNode * root,const char * correctmd5)
methods.description: Checks whether the MD5 hash of a generated file matches the expected value and prints the result.

methods.name: void insertElem(elementNode * root,char * path,rbusElementType_t type)
methods.description: Inserts a new element into the RBUS element tree at the specified path with the given type.

methods.name: void removeElem(elementNode * root,const char * path)
methods.description: Removes an element from the RBUS element tree at the specified path.

methods.name: void addRow(elementNode * root,const char * path,uint32_t insNum,const char * alias)
methods.description: Adds a new row to a table element in the RBUS element tree.

methods.name: void delRow(elementNode * root,const char * path)
methods.description: Deletes a row from a table element in the RBUS element tree.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char * argv[])
methods.description: Main function that sets up the RBUS element tree, performs insertions, deletions, and verifies the integrity via MD5 checksums.
